name: field-modulated-decay
title: Field-to-particle coupling, A_particle -> 0 at rate k·[B](x)
question:
Does the Smoldyn process read the PDE field at each molecule as vcell-fvsolver does
(nearest node, value from the previous coupling step)? Does the coupled model approach
its deterministic continuum limit?
hypothesis:
With a static field and immobile particles, each grid column survives as exp(-k·B·t)
exactly in expectation, and nothing decays where B = 0. With diffusing A and B, the
ensemble-mean particle concentration matches the all-continuous FV solution of the same
model, to within sampling noise.
objective:
Part 1: B rises linearly from 0 to 1 µM across x; 4,000 immobile A per run; k = 1/(µM·s);
8 seeds; t = 1 s. Compare per-column survival to exp(-k·B_col·t) with binomial z-scores.
Part 2: B is a Gaussian (1 µM peak, D_B = 0.5); 20,000 A with D_A = 1; 8 seeds. Compare
the ensemble-mean A (µM) at t = 1 s to continuum_model() solved by FVReactionDiffusion
alone (relative L2 over the grid, and total A).
description:
The reaction is written once in the HybridModel (A + B -> B, k). partition() sends the
PDE side nothing (B is a catalyst), and sends the particle side A -> 0 with the rate
k*B; that Smoldyn evaluates through GridValueProvider at each molecule's nearest node.
Coupling is coupling: fvsolver with k = 1 (dt = 0.01).

variants.name: native-vcell-slab
variants.note: The same model on a quasi-2D slab (11x11x3), run by both the co-simulation (Poisson initial placement) and VCell's native hybrid solver via viva_pde_particle.reference.vcell_native (pyvcell -> libvcell -> vcell-fvsolver).

behavior_tests.name: survival-follows-local-field
behavior_tests.description: Max |z| over x-columns of survivors vs N0·exp(-k·B_col·t) (static B, immobile A).

provenance.note: Smoldyn's first-order reaction probability per step is 1-exp(-rate·dt), so survival is exp(-k·B·t) exactly in expectation.

behavior_tests.name: no-decay-where-field-is-zero
behavior_tests.description: Molecules lost from the B = 0 column.

provenance.note: Rate k·0 = 0 at the B = 0 nodes.

behavior_tests.name: approaches-continuum-limit
behavior_tests.description: Relative L2 error of the ensemble-mean A (µM) vs the continuum FV solution at t = 1 s.

provenance.note: Per-node sampling noise of the 8-run mean is about 1/sqrt(8·165), roughly 2.8%; the threshold allows about 2x that.

behavior_tests.name: total-matches-continuum
behavior_tests.description: Relative error of the ensemble-mean total A vs the continuum total at t = 1 s.

provenance.note: 160,000 total molecule samples give ~0.3% sampling error on the total.

behavior_tests.name: native-vcell-follows-local-field
behavior_tests.description: Native VCell hybrid, static B (slab, 8 seeds); max |z| over x-columns of survivors vs N0·exp(-k·B·t).

provenance.note: Same exact expectation as the co-simulation test; validates the headless native reference path.

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-static
behavior_tests.description: Two-sample max |z| over x-columns of per-run survival fractions, co-simulation vs native VCell (static B).

provenance.note: Equal expected survival under both solvers; 8 runs each.

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-diffusing
behavior_tests.description: Two-sample max |z| over x-columns of the final A profile, co-simulation vs native VCell (diffusing A and B).

provenance.note: Same model, mesh and coupling scheme in both solvers; differences only from sampling (8 runs each).

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-total
behavior_tests.description: Relative difference of mean total survival, co-simulation vs native VCell (diffusing A and B).

provenance.note: 160,000 molecule samples per solver; sampling error ~0.5%.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition: The particle side reads fields correctly and the coupled model converges to its continuum limit.

canonical_runs.name: default
canonical_runs.label: Static-field column survival + continuum-limit comparison (8 seeds each)
